zh-CN.title: 发言可以分享给聊天了
items: 从发言菜单直接分享到私聊或群聊
置顶聊天优先展示，其余按最近消息排序
分享成功后会在聊天中生成完整的发言卡片

en.title: Share statements into chats
items: Share a statement to direct or group chats from its menu
Pinned chats come first, followed by recent activity
Shared statements appear as rich cards inside the conversation
